correctness.rationale: A central reduced subset need only commute with identity-containing two-point subsets, by distributivity of subset multiplication over unions. Complement intersection identities split into rotations and reflections. Rotation tests and odd-order invertibility of doubling force a single subgroup coset (or the empty reflection complement); reflection tests force an inverse-stable rotation complement inside that subgroup. Conditions are reversible and the subgroup-coset enumeration has no overlap. A self-contained exhaustive checker independently tests 5 small kernels (counts 9,25,79,287,305).

value.rationale: A complete center classification over every finite generalized dihedral group with odd abelian kernel is a natural invariant of a noncommutative power monoid. The subgroup-lattice summation detects groups of equal order (C9 versus C3×C3). The subtle distinction from the unreduced power semigroup (normal subsets) gives the result substantive structural content, not a routine parameter substitution.
